then.text: Champion! Welcome to Air Movements. Passport? Ha, no, not for the territories. They're all ours.

else.text: No rush. The next flight is always about to leave.
Sorry, civilians can't fly the Airbridge. It's the Champion's privilege: you need to have won the Open Moot, and the paperwork says you haven't yet.
Come back with a title, and I'll find you a seat. The Airbridge always has a seat. The tea is another matter.

brz_lounge.text: I've been on the Airbridge twice and I still can't sleep on it. There's a bit in the middle where it's just sea, for nine hours.
Take a cardigan. It's warm on the ground and cold on the plane, and there's a rule that the tea is never hot enough.

brz_steward.text: Hot drinks at the counter, toilets by the door, departures straight ahead.
Every territory on the board has a flight line. The pilots read them out on landing. I've heard them all.
